create_COCOEvaluator: create a COCOEvaluator instance to evaluate bbox, segm, or keypoints on a COCO dataset
run_COCOEvaluator_evaluate: run COCOEvaluator evaluate method to compute AP metrics on collected predictions
run_COCOEvaluator_process: run COCOEvaluator process method to collect model predictions into COCO JSON format
run_instances_to_coco_json: run instances_to_coco_json to convert detectron2 Instances objects into COCO evaluation JSON format
run_evaluate_box_proposals: run _evaluate_box_proposals to compute recall and AR metrics for object detection proposals
